reviews.t: Ears not pierced for earrings! Nicked skin
reviews.x: Why drill a hole from back of the ear and a separate one on the front, if they don’t connect?  It’s just to give the appearance that the hole is drilled all the way through.  It is advertised as earring display but depending on how the hole was drilled at factory, you can’t use it without bending/damaging the wire on the earring.  I returned one for that issue plus blotchy skin finish.  Replacement  arrived today with same ear issue PLUS deformed ear.  The skin finish is perfect on the replaceme

She's a beauty! Arrived quickly and in perfect condition. Her skin looks like skin-not shiny, yay! Good coloring. Truly life sized. The only downside is that the ear lobes are thick, and the holes are ONLY suitable for displaying post/stud earrings. We will have to carve away the back side of the ears so that other ear wire types can be inserted without having to bend them out of shape. That being said, we're very satisfied with her for modeling our jewelry.

In theory it sounds good but in reality she’s not functional for earrings- at all.  Know that ahead of time even though it’s advertised she can have them. claims.text: Buyers frequently praise the mannequin's attractive, life-like appearance and say it makes wigs and jewelry look beautiful.
Many reviewers report the earring holes are not drilled all the way through, making it hard or impossible to display earrings as advertised.
Customers commonly say it is well packaged and arrives in perfect condition, with several noting fast or on-time shipping.
Reviewers often describe it as good value and worth the price, especially compared to other vendors.
Some buyers note the mannequin is sturdy and works well for jewelry display, though a few mention needing modifications like drilling holes or heating pins.
